verdict: Organic presence holding steady; a web traffic drop needs a closer look.
narrative: All activity this period came from organic sources — no paid advertising ran over the last 28 days. Your Google Business Profile generated 27 actions (2 calls, 14 direction requests, 11 website clicks) across 25 active days, and week-over-week engagement on that profile is up 50%. On the other side, website sessions and search clicks both fell roughly 41% compared to the prior week — your local search visibility appears intact, so we're looking at a site or indexing issue as the likely cause, not a loss of presence. We're investigating the traffic drop now and will have a clearer picture by next week's report.
